label: 0-25 ft strong spatial agreement
notes: Very close agreement. This is separate from the final 25-ft issue threshold, which applies only after an existing point is recommended.

label: 25-75 ft normal candidate range
notes: Plausible shared physical point when corroborated by identity/context evidence.

label: 75-150 ft displaced-stop candidate range
notes: Keeps plausible displaced-stop cases (for example a stop placed about 100 ft from its partner) in the scored range, with fewer distance points than closer bands.

label: 150-200 ft evidence-assisted rescue
notes: Distance contributes no positive score. Strong non-distance identity evidence is required to connect a group.

label: 200-250 ft evidence-assisted rescue
notes: Review-only rescue band; strong non-distance evidence required.

label: 250-300 ft evidence-assisted rescue
notes: Outer rescue band; strong non-distance evidence required.
